newsitem.title: RUSSIA: NORDIC SKIING-MYLLYLA POSTS SECOND WORLD CUP WIN.
newsitem.headline: NORDIC SKIING-MYLLYLA POSTS SECOND WORLD CUP WIN.

text.p: Finland's Mika Myllyla posted his second career World Cup Nordic win on Saturday with a victory in the 30km freestyle cross-country race.

Myllyla, who won the 10km freestyle competition in Davos last month, finished in one hour 12 minutes and 47 seconds. His compatriots Jari Isometsa and Sami Repo, like Myllyla members of Finland's winning relay team in Davos, came in seventh and ninth place respectively.
"This is a lucky day for me," said Myllyla after the race, which took place in hilly terrain just outside Russia's second city of St Petersburg.
A bronze and silver medallist at the Lillehammer Olympics and a bronze medallist at the 1995 world championships, Myllyla said he was now setting his sights on the Olympics next year.
Fulvio Valbusa came second in one hour 13 minutes and 29.1 seconds, followed by fellow Italian Maurizio Pozzi on 1:13:33.8.

Bjoern Daehlie of Norway, who won the season-opening freestyle cross-country race last November and in the process eclipsed Swede Gunde Svan's record of 30 World Cup wins, finished in fourth place, clocking 1:13:42.9.
